title: Tạo bức ảnh du lịch chân thật bằng chatgpt trong 1 phút với lệnh sau:...
description: Tạo bức ảnh du lịch chân thật bằng chatgpt trong 1 phút với lệnh sau: Create an ultra-realistic travel photograph using the uploaded person as the ONLY subject. IMPORTANT: - Preserve the person's identity exactly. - Do NOT change facial features, expression, smile, skin tone, hairstyle, body proportions, or age. - The final result must look like this person actually traveled to this location and was photographed there. - No AI-looking artifacts or stylization. SCENE: The location is Oia, Santorini, Greece, overlooking the famous caldera at golden hour. The viewpoint is from a whitewashed terrace with the iconic blue-domed church positioned prominently in the lower-left foreground. Vast deep-blue Aegean Sea fills the left half of the frame. Across the sea, the volcanic cliffs stretch horizontally through the background with soft atmospheric haze. Traditional white Cycladic buildings with blue domes cascade down the cliff on the right side. COMPOSITION: - Landscape orientation (4:3). - Wide-angle travel photography (approximately 28–35mm full-frame equivalent). - Camera positioned slightly above seated eye level. - The blue dome occupies the lower-left foreground. - The subject sits naturally on the curved white wall in the lower-right third of the frame. - Large negative space showing the sea and cliffs. - Horizon in the upper third. - Rule-of-thirds composition. SUBJECT POSE: - Sitting abit sideways on the white curved wall. - Legs relaxed and naturally hanging. - Body turned about 30 degrees toward the camera. - Looking to the came. - Natural genuine smile. - Holding a camera loosely with both hands on the lap. - Relaxed shoulders and authentic vacation posture. LIGHTING: - Warm sunset backlighting. - Sun positioned high-right outside the frame. - Soft golden rim light outlining the hair and shoulders. - Gentle lens flare. - Soft long shadows. - Balanced HDR exposure. - Bright sky without blown highlights. - Slight atmospheric haze over distant cliffs. ENVIRONMENT DETAILS: - White stucco architecture with realistic texture. - Bright cobalt blue church dome. - Crystal-clear blue sea. - Natural reflections on the water. - Small boats far below. - Warm Mediterranean atmosphere. - Clean white walls with subtle imperfections. - High-end travel destination aesthetic. CAMERA SETTINGS: - Full-frame mirrorless camera. - 35mm lens. - f/4 - ISO 100 - 1/500 sec. - Natural depth of field. - High dynamic range. - Editorial travel photography quality. - National Geographic / Condé Nast Traveler style. - Extremely realistic color grading. QUALITY: Photorealistic, indistinguishable from a real photograph, ultra-detailed, natural skin texture, realistic lighting, accurate perspective, high resolution, authentic travel photo. #nguyenvansuai #johnnguyen #chatgpt #AItrending
